name: Baikonur Site 200
tagline: Proton-M heavy-lift pad — Mir modules, ISS Zvezda/Zarya, GLONASS, Luna 25
description: Baikonur Site 200 hosts pads PU-1 (LC200/39) and PU-2 (LC200/40) for the Proton-K and Proton-M heavy-lift rockets. From here Roscosmos has launched almost every Mir module, the ISS modules Zarya and Zvezda, multiple Salyut stations, the GLONASS navigation constellation, and Luna 25 (2023). Site 200 remains active alongside Site 81 for Proton's final operational years.
